integrity: The conclusion follows from an explicit complete finite acyclic matching and integral homotopy attachment calculation; source publication dates are attached to the original arXiv versions.
scientific_limitations: Only the second discrete-Morse iterate of the three-cycle is classified; mod-two homology rank 64 was already published, and a potentially overlapping directed-forest thesis was not available in full. No independent audit is claimed.
title: The second discrete-Morse iterate of a triangle is \(\bigvee^{64}S^4\)
